sections.title: SIGN UP ONLINE OR IN THE LOBBY
sections.body:
PUREHEART.ORG/HEARTCREWS
ROOTED
Go deeper. Live on purpose. Rooted
is an 11-week small-group
experience designed to help you
grow deeper in your relationship
with God while building authentic
community. Through biblical
teaching, meaningful conversations,
prayer, serving, and practical
experiences, you'll discover what it
means to follow Jesus in everyday
life. Real community. Deeper faith.
Weds · 6:30-8:00 PM
PHC Glendale
Join Rooted →

sections.title: COURSES + MORE
sections.body:
FAMILY SCHOOL
Build a stronger family.
Grow together. Come join Pastor
Bryan and Megan for an interactive
experience designed for your whole
family. You'll learn practical skills and
tools that, along with the Holy Spirit,
will help you become the family God
intended. Children ages 12 and up
are encouraged to participate in the
experience, and childcare is
available for younger children.
Begins Sept 16
Weds · 6:30-8:00 PM
PHC Glendale
Join Family School →

sections.title: POWER TO HEAL
sections.body:
7-Week Interactive Prayer Class
Whether you're just beginning your
prayer journey or have been praying
for years, this course will challenge,
equip, and strengthen your prayer life.
Together, we'll explore the Power to
Heal book and videos by Randy Clark,
with practical biblical teaching on
praying for spirit, soul, and body. Each
session includes:
Inspiring video teaching
Interactive prayer activities
Hands-on opportunities to put
what you learn into practice
Come expecting to grow in
confidence, deepen your relationship
with God, and experience a fresh
impact in your personal prayer life.
Cost: $16+tax · No childcare available.
Begins Aug 29
Sat · 2:30-5:00 PM
PHC Glendale
Join Power to Heal  →

sections.body:
Weds · 7:00-8:00 PM
PHC Peoria
An intimate opportunity to deepen your
connection with God and come
together in prayer. Each gathering
includes prayer, worship music,
Scripture readings, testimonies, and
intercessory prayer. All are welcome!

sections.title: WEEKLY ZOOM PRAYER
sections.body:
Join us every Weds for a meaningful
time of prayer, encouragement, and
connection. Together, we'll seek God's
presence, strengthen one another, and
cultivate deeper relationships through
heartfelt prayer. Whether you join us
weekly or as your schedule allows,
you're always welcome.
Come expecting God
to move!
Weds · 6:00-6:45 PM
Online
